name: Rorian the Dayseeker
summary: In Thendal Village, young Skyborne look to Rorian the Dayseeker as they approach adulthood. He teaches them to survive, honor tradition, and serve their island home.

sections.title: Elder of Thendal Village
sections.body: In Thendal Village on Zephras Isle, Rorian the Dayseeker guides young Skyborne through the passage into adulthood. Under his calm instruction, fledglings face a traditional rite that marks their readiness to defend and support their island home.

sections.title: Guiding the New Callings
sections.body: Rorian also directs promising fledglings toward callings suited to their talents. Aspiring warriors, hunters, rogues, mages, shamans, and druids find trainers across the isle through his guidance. When elemental disturbances trouble the island, he alerts them and teaches them to preserve its balance.

faq.answer: Rorian the Dayseeker is an elder Skyborne leader in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. He guides young Skyborne through their early trials.

faq.q: Where can Rorian the Dayseeker be found?
faq.answer: Rorian is in Thendal Village, the Skyborne starting settlement on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What is Rorian's role in the Skyborne coming of age?
faq.answer: Rorian guides fledglings through rites of passage into adulthood. He tests their mettle and attunement to island life, then sends them to serve the wider settlement.

faq.q: How does Rorian direct new trainees into their classes?
faq.answer: Once a novice proves their worth, Rorian points them toward advanced training as a warrior, hunter, rogue, mage, shaman, or druid.

faq.q: Why does Rorian send adventurers to deal with elementals?
faq.answer: Rorian sends capable initiates to investigate and calm elemental unrest. Their efforts help preserve harmony in Thendal Village and the surrounding wildlands.

faq.q: Who is Aetheen of the Gales?
faq.answer: Aetheen of the Gales is on Zephras Isle. Rorian directs fledglings to them as they progress through their island responsibilities and training.

angles.text: As a fledgling Skyborne, you meet Rorian the Dayseeker at the first threshold of duty and tradition. He guides your passage into adulthood in Thendal Village.
Rorian sees your dedication as an aspiring warrior and points you toward mentors who teach battlefield discipline.
As a novice arcanist, you find an understanding guide in Rorian. He directs you toward teachers who can hone your magical potential.
Rorian stresses the island's harmony and sends you to soothe agitated elementals and connect with ancestral traditions.
